title: Run verifyCommands sequentially
instructions:
Implement only Slice 2 of Core worker execution trust hardening: make evaluateWorkerResult run task.verifyCommands sequentially by default and stop after the first failing verify command.

Required behavior:
- Replace the current parallel verify command execution with serial execution in declaration order.
- Stop running further verify commands after the first non-zero exit code.
- Preserve VerifyCommandResult timing fields for every executed command.
- Preserve existing HARNESS_RESULT parsing, changed-file collection, scope checks, no-op writer pass gate behavior from Slice 1, worker verify evidence parsing, and report-only behavior.
- Do not add parallelSafeVerifyCommands, timeout behavior, CLI surface, daemon/watch behavior, dashboard behavior, remote adapter behavior, multi-project orchestration, writerCap changes, hidden memory, LLM semantic verification, task templates, agent profile edits, run lifecycle changes, or documentation edits.

Required tests:
- Prove verifyCommands execute in declaration order.
- Prove evaluation stops at the first failing verify command and does not execute later commands.
- Update existing worker-result tests that previously expected every verify command to run after failure.
- Keep existing pass/fail semantics and timing assertions for executed verify commands.

Implementation guidance: keep the change local to worker-result evaluation. Prefer a small helper such as runVerifyCommands if it makes the serial behavior easier to test and read. End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
